behavior: A lane pull request is declared unreviewed whatever its files, with the lane's rationale.
A red lane pull request opens one issue, a second red run updates it, and a green run closes it.
Only a verified action digest bump outside the caller's production paths merges, pinned to the verified head commit.
Committed tests fail if the merge class widens or the merging condition or head-commit pin changes; allow_auto_merge stays false.
Release-please pull requests are declared unreviewed and never merged by the lane.
Caller fixtures for two repositories, one with production paths.
